description: Indus Dyeing & Manufacturing Company Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 23 July 1957 and its principal activity is the manufacturing and sale of yarn, carried out at plants in Karachi, Hyderabad and Muzaffargarh. It is part of the Indus Group, and its subsidiaries are Indus Lyallpur Limited, Indus Home Limited (which itself holds Indus Home USA Inc.) and Indus Wind Energy Limited, with Sunrays Textile Mills Limited as an associated undertaking.
